correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the precise tournaplex F_t={nonempty 11-vertex masks with at most t cyclic triples}. Independently enumerated all 165 triples, found 55 cyclic, 2,047 nonempty faces and exactly 17 threshold values 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,11,12,13,18,19,28,40,55. Fresh signed finite-field reductions of all 2,047 filtration columns independently matched complete supplied F2 barcode (727 positive-length intervals, 20 types) and F3 barcode (726 intervals, 18 types), both with 1,023 finite simplex pairs, all bars finite after reduced H0. Fresh sparse integral unit-pivot Smith reductions for every degree at all 17 thresholds checked all rank-one residual 2×2 minors and gcd invariant; the only nonunit factors are 2 in ∂3 at level 0 and 2 in ∂6 at level 12. All free ranks, mod-2 UCT and F3 ranks agree with the three exact CSV files. The independent replay code `/mnt/data/test_scope_3.py` exited with both PALEY11_INDEPENDENT_PERSISTENCE_CHECK_OK and PALEY11_INDEPENDENT_INTEGRAL_SMITH_CHECK_OK. This is exhaustive for 11 vertices; no integral interval decomposition or family generalization.

value.rationale: The precise recurrence and disappearance/reappearance of integral 2-torsion in a canonical doubly regular tournament distinguishes filtration stages invisible in its previously classified unweighted directed flag complex. A complete reproducible pair of coefficient-dependent barcodes and all integral stage invariants provide a natural finite benchmark for directionality persistence, including UCT-driven crosschecks; intrinsically useful exact finite classification, not arbitrary slicing.

limitations: Only c3 motif filtration of Paley tournament order 11; integer thresholds include all real t by constant-on-interval rule.
